harness.name: Gemini CLI
harness.mode: non-interactive (-p), --yolo --skip-trust; the full text of PROMPT.md passed verbatim as the -p argument
harness.auth: Google AI Studio API key (GEMINI_API_KEY) with an isolated HOME; the key itself is not recorded
harness.coordinator: Muse (separate session): prepared the workspace, launched and monitored the run, validated and collected the artifacts without changing the entrant's geometry, materials or code
harness.first_attempt_failed: The first launch at 09:30:44 JST exited with code 41 before any API use: the coordinator's launcher read the API key through a path that broke under the isolated HOME. Fixed to an absolute path and relaunched at 09:31:34 JST; the failed attempt incurred no cost.

usage.counting: Counted by the coordinator from the Gemini CLI session JSONL, deduplicated by message id. API calls are the completed model responses carrying token records; tool calls are the functionCall parts in the model messages.

cost_estimate.basis: Billed per API call against the Google AI Studio API key. The USD figure is an estimate computed from the recorded token usage at the introductory rates (valid until 2026-11-30).

harness.name: Antigravity CLI (agy)
harness.mode: Interactive TUI in the user's own GUI session, operated by the coordinator via Computer Use. The model was set to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh) with /model before the task. The task was delivered as a single instruction to read PROMPT.md and follow it exactly, working only in the workspace; PROMPT.md is byte-identical to the canonical prompts/01-procedural.md (confirmed by the coordinator validation), so the delivery method differs from Carbon's verbatim -p argument while the prompt content is identical.
harness.auth: Google OAuth (personal account), Google AI Ultra plan
harness.coordinator: Muse (separate session): prepared the workspace, started and monitored the run through the GUI, validated and collected the artifacts without changing the entrant's geometry, materials or code
harness.interventions: Twice during the run the agent paused at file-read permission prompts for its own preview images (scratch_previews/preview_34.png and preview_back.png); the coordinator approved them as safe reads of files inside the workspace. No other coordinator input was given.

timeline_jst.agent_seconds_note: Start is the task submission observed by the coordinator in the TUI; finish is the last deliverable write (README.md at 11:11:18 JST). Both are approximate to the minute.
timeline_jst.agent_exit_note: Interactive TUI run: the agent printed its completion summary and returned to its input prompt; no process exit code exists.

usage.note: Antigravity does not expose per-token usage; the run consumed Google AI Ultra plan quota instead of per-call API billing.

cost_estimate.basis: Google AI Ultra subscription quota; no per-API-call charge.

verification.rebuilt_png_note: The rebuild completed with exit code 0 and all five renders at the expected dimensions, but the pixel data differs from the originals; the scene's procedural hair and fuzz elements do not reproduce pixel-for-pixel.

privacy.note: Astra: privacy scan clean (the entrant's build script scrubbed local paths before saving). Sol: character.blend and the five render PNGs contain the Mac account name in Blender's File metadata absolute path, the same as the published Kimi, Terra and Carbon collections; collected unmodified following those precedents. One additional Sol hit is a false positive: the '@' matrix operator in report_scene.py matched the e-mail pattern. No secrets in either run. Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen: character.blend and the five render PNGs likewise contain the Mac account name in Blender's File metadata path; collected unmodified following the same precedent. No secrets in either Gemini run.
